title: Remy is amazing!!
text: This tour was so fun. The food was great but the best part was the guide, Remy!!! He was so fun, knowledgeable, funny, and really made the experience. Highly recommend the tour & Remy!!!

title: This tour with Remy is a MUST in Seville
text: Remy was the most enthusiastic guide we have had on this trip! He took us to to four wonderful places for food and drink and explained everything in great detail. He was an absolute joy and someone I will remember for a long time. Highly recommend!
